# Know Your Meme

> > Encyclopedia and documentation hub for internet memes, viral trends, and online culture phenomena, primarily from TikTok, Twitter/X, and other social platforms.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive reference for understanding viral content, internet slang, and digital culture trends. The site documents meme origins, spread patterns, and cultural context through detailed entries, explainer guides, and curated collections.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Catchphrases
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Internet slang
- Viral video explanations
- Twitter/X culture
- DeviantArt
- Dance memes
- Nostalgia memes
- Hood saxophone trend
- Looksmaxxing culture
- Breaking Bad memes
- Mental health memes

## Viral Meme Entries

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme from DeviantArt art by t-a-t-k-a, viral on TikTok
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme viral on TikTok
